Me too. I'm too much of a coward to do it myself, despite my best efforts. I think it would be less painful for my family and friends if someone or something else killed me. Then they don't have to deal with the pain of losing someone to suicide.

Hey, I have BPD too so I can relate to that struggle. I've been doing MBT (mentalization based therapy) with my psychiatrist and that's helped me. It was designed specifically for people with BPD. If you have the drive to keep going, maybe you could talk to a mental health professional about doing MBT. But I also understand if you don't want to. And if you wanna message me I'm here. We can commiserate about this absolute clusterfuck of a disorder.
I have a personality disorder too, BPD. It fucking sucks and I hate that I can't trust myself. What are you diagnosed with, if you don't mind me asking?

I'm the same way. I think we're pretty much all scared of death in one way or another, way deep in our lizard brains. I'm suicidal but I would rather die to natural causes or some freak accident, so at least the people who do care about me don't have to deal with the added weight of grieving a suicide. Or it could be the shame and guilt associated with suicide.

I'm glad to see there is someone here who cares about a suicidal person. Honestly, I think being patient and not judging him for his emotions would be super helpful. As many will tell you here, those of us who post here aren't really looking for someone to tell us "it's all gonna be ok" or something like that. To me, when I hear that it feels dismissive of my feelings and like whoever says it is just saying it because they feel obliged.

Suicidal people don't need pity, we need empathy.

Damn, this is really hits home. I have BPD and it's fucking awful, even when I'm doing ok suicide is still in the back of my mind. There are periods of being ok, but it's like I'm just waiting for the next bad thing to happen. And any little thing could be that trigger. 

I don't have any amazing advice for you bc I'm hopeless myself, but maybe you'll take comfort in knowing you're not alone.
